heading: Notes
content: Bunco requires no strategy. The table rotation ensures players interact with all participants over the course of the game.

heading: Aasimar
content: This supernaturally beautiful woman looks human, yet emanates a strange sense of calm and benevolence.

heading: Aboleth
content: Four long tentacles writhe from this three-eyed fish-like creature's flanks, and its green body glistens with thick, clear slime.

heading: Angel, Astral Deva
content: This tall, human-like creature has long, feathery wings and a gentle inner radiance that makes it difficult to look directly at.

heading: Angel, Planetar
content: Muscular, bald, and tall, this humanoid creature has emerald skin and two pairs of shining, white-feathered wings.

heading: Angel, Solar
content: This towering humanoid creature has shining topaz eyes, metallic skin, and three pairs of white wings.

heading: Animated Object
content: The skeleton locked within rattles as this animated cage lurches forward on chain legs in search of new prisoners.

heading: Ankheg
content: This burrowing, bug-like monster scuttles about on six legs, drooling noxious green ichor from its clacking mandibles.

heading: Ant, Giant
content: A thin, six-legged ant the size of a pony stands at the ready, its mandibles chittering and its stinger dripping with venom.

heading: Ape, Dire
content: Sharp teeth fill this large, feral ape's mouth, and its long, muscular arms stretch to the ground, ending in wickedly curved claws.

heading: Ape, Gorilla
content: Large, deep-set eyes peer from beneath this great ape's thick brow as it lumbers forward on its legs and knuckles.

heading: Archon, Hound
content: This canine-headed humanoid's well-groomed appearance and polished greatsword show it to be more than a common beast.

heading: Archon, Lantern
content: Shedding a warm and calming radiance, this orb of light moves with a preternatural silence and otherworldly grace.

heading: Archon, Trumpet
content: Lithe and beautiful, with skin the color of marble, this being hovers upon powerful, white wings and radiates a sense of serenity.

heading: Assassin Vine
content: This gnarled vine, as thick as a man's arm and bearing hand-shaped leaves, convulses across the ground in an unnatural slither.

heading: Azata, Bralani
content: Silver-white hair the color of a lightning strike whips about this poised elf-like archer, his eyes swirling with vibrant colors.

heading: Azata, Ghaele
content: This elegantly armored sentinel stands alert, her eyes radiating divine light and her noble blade crackling with power.

heading: Barghest
content: This lupine, goblinoid creature grins with feral cunning, its clawed hands twitching in anticipation of the kill.

heading: Barghest, Greater
content: Barghest, Greater Outsider

heading: Basidirond
content: This strange plant consists of four spidery stalks, long green tendrils, and an inverted bell-shaped cap filled with spores.

heading: Basilisk
content: This squat, reptilian monster has eight legs, bony spurs jutting from its back, and eyes that glow with pale green fire.

heading: Bat, Dire
content: This giant, furry bat is nearly the size of an ox, with dark leathery wings that open wider than two men with arms outstretched.

heading: Bear, Dire
content: Spittle drips from this feral bear's roaring maw, and its matted fur is broken in places by wicked, bony growths.

heading: Bear, Grizzly
content: Broad, powerful muscles move beneath this massive bear's brown fur, promising both speed and lethal force.

heading: Bebilith
content: A spider the size of an elephant, this dark blue arachnid rears up on its six hind legs to raise its barbed and razor-edged front claws.

heading: Beetle, Fire
content: This housecat-sized beetle is a dull brown color brightened by two glowing green-yellow spots on its carapace.

heading: Beetle, Giant Stag
content: With a sleek body and huge mandibles raised in a threatening pose, this large beetle stands firm in defense of its territory.

heading: Behir
content: This slithering, multilegged blue reptile has a fearsome head crowned with two large, curling horns.

heading: Black Pudding
content: This black, amorphous blob piles up on itself, a quivering mound of midnight sludge that glistens darkly before surging forward.

heading: Boar
content: This ill-tempered beast's tiny, bloodshot eyes glare angrily above a mouth filled with sharp tusks.

heading: Boar, Dire
content: The back of this horse-sized boar rises in a steep slope. Its tiny red eyes are crusted with filth and its bristly flank crawls with flies.

heading: Boggard
content: Bulbous eyes glare atop this creature's decidedly toad-like head. A multitude of warts and bumps decorate its greenish skin.

heading: Bugbear
content: This dark-furred creature raises a spiked morningstar, its tiny, milk-white eyes glittering with the thrill of the coming kill.

heading: Bulette
content: This armor-plated creature's toothy maw gapes wide as a fin-like dorsal plate rises between its shoulders.

heading: Azata, Lillend
content: This creature has the body of a seductive, winged elven woman from the waist up and that of a snake from the waist down.

heading: Cat, Cheetah
content: This large, sleek feline has a golden coat spotted with black. Its long and powerful legs are obviously capable of great speed.

heading: Cat, Leopard
content: With each graceful step, this leopard's steely muscles ripple beneath its spotted fur.

heading: Cave Fisher
content: This man-sized, crab-like monstrosity clings tenaciously to the rough stone, its enormous pincers held out menacingly before it.

heading: Centaur
content: This creature has the sun-bronzed upper body of a seasoned warrior and the lower body of a sleek warhorse.

heading: Centipede, Giant
content: This lengthy, segmented horror writhes and twists, pulsing its venomous mandibles in search of prey.

heading: Chimera
content: This winged monster has the body of a lion, though two more heads flank its central feline one—a dragon and a horned goat.

heading: Choker
content: This hunched-over wretch has long, pliable arms like tentacles capped with five wide, spiny claws.

heading: Chuul
content: This lobster-like creature has a thick armored shell. A pair of tiny eyes gleams above a mouth full of writhing tentacles.

heading: Cloaker
content: This ray-like creature opens a toothy maw and leers with glaring red eyes. Behind it whips a menacing tail of segmented bone.

heading: Cockatrice
content: This hideous avian creature has the body of an emaciated rooster, the wings of a bat, and a long, scaly tail.

heading: Couatl
content: This great serpent has multicolored wings and eyes that glimmer with intense awareness.

heading: Crab, Giant
content: This lumbering hard-shelled crab stands as tall as a dwarf, its massive pincers waving menacingly.

heading: Crocodile
content: This reptile lunges out of the placid water with shocking speed. Its jaw gapes open in a roar, its powerful tail lashing behind.

heading: Crocodile, Dire
content: This reptilian behemoth, a crocodile of monstrous proportions, is large enough to swallow a horse in one tremendous bite.

heading: Cyclops
content: A single huge eye stares from the forehead of this nine-foot-tall giant. Below this sole orb, an even larger mouth gapes like a cave.

heading: Dark Creeper
content: Filthy, reeking black rags wrap this small humanoid from head to toe, leaving only its hands and pale white nose visible.

heading: Dark Stalker
content: This tall humanoid's pale brow and black, soulless eyes are all that can be seen above a black scarf wrapped around its face.

heading: Darkmantle
content: As this creature falls from the cavern roof, it opens like a hideous octopus, its thin, hook-lined tentacles connected by a fleshy web.

heading: Demon, Babau
content: This emaciated figure looks like a horned human skeleton smothered within a bone-tight hide of slimy leather.

heading: Demon, Balor
content: When folk whisper frightened tales of the demonic, what most envision is a towering figure of fire and flesh, a horned nightmare armed with flaming whip and sword flying through the night in search of

heading: Demon, Dretch
content: This creature's bloated frame shudders with each heaving step, yet despite its shape, the thing moves with surprising quickness.

heading: Demon, Glabrezu
content: Four arms grace the torso of this towering monstrosity. The monster's eyes shine with a mix of intelligence and cruelty.

heading: Demon, Hezrou
content: This fiend's armored flesh is scaly and moist. Its large, toothy mouth gapes below a pair of hungry, reptilian eyes.

heading: Demon, Marilith
content: This snake-bodied fiend has a six-armed woman's torso, pointed ears, and glittering, otherworldly eyes.

heading: Demon, Nabasu
content: This lanky fiend's mouth is filled with sharp fangs, while great bat-like wings stretch from its scaly hide.

heading: Demon, Nalfeshnee
content: A towering, corpulent beast, this fiend has the hideous head of a boar and arms ending in fatty, four-fingered hands.

heading: Demon, Quasit
content: Ram horns curl back from the twisted head of this tiny winged demon, and its body is thin and wiry.

heading: Demon, Shadow
content: Only this shadowy bat-winged demon's teeth and claws have any sense of physicality to them—the rest is lost in darkness.

heading: Demon, Succubus
content: Tiny horns, bat-like wings, and a sinuous tail betray the demonic nature of this alluring woman.

heading: Demon, Vrock
content: A cloud of spores and a trail of feathers surrounds this twisted cross between a man and a gigantic vulture.

heading: Derro
content: This pale blue humanoid has bulging white eyes, wild hair, four-fingered hands, and a large hooked club.

heading: Devil, Barbed
content: From the tip of its lashing tail to the serrated features of its fang-filled visage, this fiery-eyed sentinel bristles with barbs.

heading: Devil, Bearded
content: This seething devil deftly wields a vicious, saw-toothed glaive, while below its toothy maw writhes a hideous, twitching beard.

heading: Devil, Bone
content: Merging the most horrifying features of carrion-fed insect and withered cadaver, this bony devil moves in unsettling lurches.

heading: Devil, Erinyes
content: Some calamity has befallen this angelic warrior. Wings stained black shear the air as her merciless eyes search for a target.

heading: Devil, Horned
content: Bristling with terrible spines and a crown of deadly horns, this leering winged terror wields a whirling barbed chain.

heading: Devil, Ice
content: A pair of frozen, multifaceted eyes coldly judge all before this towering, insectile monstrosity.

heading: Devil, Imp
content: Fiendish wings and a whipping scorpion-like tail lash behind this diminutive, red-skinned nuisance.

heading: Devil, Lemure
content: A roiling wave of flesh gushes forward. Amid the fatty surge wriggle half-formed limbs and a dripping tumorous face.

heading: Devourer
content: This dry, hovering corpse's chest is a prison of jagged ribs, within which is trapped a small tormented ghostly form.

heading: Dinosaur, Ankylosaurus
content: Thick bony plates armor the domelike back of this quadrupedal dinosaur, its powerfully muscled tail ending in a bony club.

heading: Dinosaur, Brachiosaurus
content: A long tail counterbalances this reptile's equally long neck, at the end of which a relatively small head pulls food from the treetop.

heading: Dinosaur, Deinonychus
content: This brightly colored dinosaur exudes a dangerous ferocity. Each foot is armed with a large, sickle-shaped claw.

heading: Dinosaur, Elasmosaurus
content: Long-necked and long-tailed, this large, predatory reptile glides through the water on four powerful flippers.

heading: Dinosaur, Pteranodon
content: This flying reptile has two huge wings and a distinctive backward-sweeping crest decorating its head.

heading: Dinosaur, Stegosaurus
content: This huge dinosaur has a small head, twin rows of sharp dorsal plates, and a muscular tail terminating in a set of bony spikes.

heading: Dinosaur, Triceratops
content: This beast's armored head has three sharp horns decorating its face and a large round crest angling back over its neck from its skull.

heading: Dinosaur, Tyrannosaurus
content: This bipedal dinosaur's front arms seem small compared to the rest of its bulk, but its enormous head is all teeth.

heading: Dog
content: Dog Animal

heading: Dog, Riding
content: This burly dog is fitted with a small saddle. A low, menacing growl rumbles up from its chest.

heading: Dolphin
content: This streamlined, fish-like mammal has sparkling eyes over a smiling mouth filled with hundreds of teeth.

heading: Dolphin, Orca
content: This sleek black whale has a distinctive white patch near each eye and a mouth filled with sharp teeth.

heading: Doppelganger
content: This grayish humanoid creature seems almost unfinished, with a narrow head, gaunt limbs, and a sinister, noseless face.

heading: Dracolisk
content: This six-legged dragon flaps its massive wings as it lowers its head to glare with hideous glowing eyes.

heading: Drider
content: The dry rasping of spidery legs brings this hideous monstrosity into view—a nightmarish, centaurian fusion of drow and spider.

heading: Drow
content: This dark-skinned elf stands in a battle-ready pose, her hair silver and eyes white and pupilless.

heading: Drow Noble
content: Drow Noble Humanoid

heading: Dryad
content: This strange, beautiful woman has flesh that seems made of wood and vibrant hair that resembles leaves and blossoms.

heading: Duergar
content: This bald, long-bearded dwarf has dull gray skin, low arching brows, and eyes that seem to absorb rather than reflect the light.

heading: Eagle
content: This magnificent bird of prey has dark feathers save for those on its head, which are pure white.

heading: Eagle, Giant
content: This immense eagle's feathers are golden brown and shimmer in the light. Its sharp beak and curved talons are dark yellow.

heading: Eel, Electric
content: This six-foot-long, snake-like fish moves slowly. A strange popping and snapping sound occasionally emits from the creature's body.

heading: Eel, Giant Moray
content: This sixteen-foot-long eel slithers through the water with uncanny grace, mouth open to display large teeth and a second set of jaws.

heading: Ettercap
content: This hideous purple creature walks upright like a man, but its face is that of a spider, and its hands are sickle-shaped claws.

heading: Ettin
content: This lumbering, filthy, two-headed giant wears tattered remnants of leather armor and clutches a large flail in each fist.

heading: Dragon Turtle
content: This long-tailed aquatic beast resembles a massive snapping turtle with draconic features.

heading: Flytrap, Giant
content: This towering plant is a mass of vines and barbs. Several stalks are horribly mobile, each ending in a set of green, toothy jaws.

heading: Frog, Giant
content: This creature looks like a normal frog, with moist, mottled, blackish-green skin, but grown to truly monstrous size.

heading: Frog, Poison
content: This small frog is bright green and red, with electric-blue stripes on its hind legs.

heading: Froghemoth
content: This immense, three-eyed frog-like creature rears up on powerful hind legs. In place of arms, four huge tentacles thrash and writhe.

heading: Gargoyle
content: Seemingly carved from a dark gray stone, this sinister crouching humanoid resembles a horned, winged demon.

heading: Gelatinous Cube
content: Bits of broken weapons, coins, and a partially digested skeleton are visible inside this quivering cube of slime.

heading: Genie, Djinni
content: This creature stands nearly twice as tall as a human, although its lower torso trails away into a vortex of mist and wind.

heading: Genie, Efreeti
content: This muscular giant has crimson skin, smoldering eyes, and small black horns. Smoke rises in curls from its flesh.

heading: Genie, Janni
content: This regal figure looks like a tall, well-proportioned human, save that its eyes sparkle with strange light.

heading: Genie, Marid
content: This being resembles a powerful giant with hairless blue-green skin, deep blue eyes, flamboyant eyebrows, and pearlescent teeth.

heading: Genie, Shaitan
content: This being resembles a towering human with skin of polished stone and glittering agate eyes.

heading: Ghost
content: This spectral, horrifying figure glides silently through the air, passing through solid objects as if they didn't exist. This sample ghost is built from a 7th-level human aristocrat — the spirit of a

heading: Ghoul
content: This humanoid creature has long, sharp teeth, and its pallid flesh is stretched tightly over its starved frame.

heading: Giant, Cloud
content: This towering giant has finely chiseled features. Her skin is pale and smooth, and her long wispy hair flutters as if in a breeze.

heading: Giant, Fire
content: This lumbering giant has short stumpy legs and powerful, muscular arms. Its hair and beard seem to be made of fire.

heading: Giant, Frost
content: This giant looks like a thick, muscular human. It has frost-white skin and long, light blue hair that it wears braided.

heading: Giant, Hill
content: This hunched giant exudes power and a crude, stupid anger, its filthy fur clothing bespeaking a brutish and backwoods lifestyle.

heading: Giant, Stone
content: This giant has chiseled, muscular features and a flat, forward-sloping head, looking almost as if it were carved of stone.

heading: Giant, Storm
content: This giant is a towering, muscular human of heroic proportions, with bronze skin, dark hair, and sparkling green eyes.

heading: Gibbering Mouther
content: This horrid mass of eyes, mouths, and formless flesh stares in all directions, its countless maws yammering ceaselessly.

heading: Girallon
content: This four-armed, gorilla-like creature, covered with matted white fur, roars in rage as it rears up to its full, towering height.

heading: Gnoll
content: Hunched and feral, this furred, hyena-headed humanoid stands slightly taller than the average human.

heading: Goblin
content: This creature stands barely three feet tall, its scrawny, humanoid body dwarfed by its wide, ungainly head.

heading: Goblin Dog
content: This mangy canine's face has the same flat nose, beady eyes, and protruding teeth as a rat grown grotesquely large.

heading: Golem, Clay
content: A clay golem wears no clothing except for a metal or stiff leather garment around its hips. It stands over 8 feet tall and weighs 600 pounds.

heading: Golem, Flesh
content: A flesh golem is a ghoulish collection of stolen humanoid body parts, stitched together into a single composite form. Its cadaverous flesh has a sickly green or yellowish tint. A flesh golem wears wha

heading: Golem, Ice
content: Ice golems are humanoid automatons formed of carved ice. Their appearance can range from roughly chiseled figures of ice and snow to elaborately detailed ice sculptures and beautiful crystalline statu

heading: Golem, Iron
content: An iron golem has a humanoid body made from iron. It can be sculpted into any shape its creator desires, but it almost always displays armor of some sort, from simple and utilitarian to ceremonial and

heading: Golem, Stone
content: A stone golem has a humanoid body made from stone, frequently stylized to suit its creator. For example, it might look like it is wearing armor, with a particular symbol carved on the breastplate, or

heading: Golem, Wood
content: A wood golem is carved from rare woods, assembled into a roughly humanoid body with articulated limbs. Their creators usually leave their bodies almost unfinished, with individual pieces of lumber and

heading: Gorgon
content: This bull-like creature seems to be made of interlocking metallic plates. Faint plumes of green smoke puff from its mouth.

heading: Gray Ooze
content: A seemingly mundane puddle, patch of moist stone, or glistening rock is suddenly revealed to be more as a terrible pseudopod lashes out.

heading: Green Hag
content: Knots of dark, moldering hair spill over the features of this sickly, thin, green-skinned crone.

heading: Griffon
content: This majestic beast has the body of a lion, the head and forelegs of a great eagle, and a massive pair of feathered wings.

heading: Harpy
content: Save for the tattered wings and taloned feet, this creature resembles a feral woman with a wild look about her.

heading: Hell Hound
content: This creature resembles a thin, lanky wolf with reddish-brown fur, white claws, and burning, fiery red eyes.

heading: Hell Hound, Nessian
content: This creature resembles a powerfully built wolf the size of a large draft horse, with ebony fur and burning, fiery red eyes.

heading: Herd Animal, Aurochs
content: This large, horned bull has a dirty black hide and an aggressive temper. Its horns are wide and sharp.

heading: Herd Animal, Bison
content: This creature has small, upward-pointing horns, a shaggy coat of fur, and a large hump on its shoulders.

heading: Hobgoblin
content: Standing as tall as a human, this muscular, gray-skinned creature peers about with tiny, observant eyes.

heading: Homunculus
content: This vaguely humanoid creature is about the size of a cat but looks more like a toothy, winged devil.

heading: Horse
content: This proud horse thunders across the grassy plain with fluid grace, wind tugging at its loose-fitting barding.

heading: Horse, Pony
content: This squat equine plods forward with large, curious eyes. As it nears, it extends its muzzle, clearly expecting a treat.

heading: Human Skeleton
content: Human Skeleton Undead

heading: Human Zombie
content: Human Zombie Undead

heading: Hydra
content: Multiple angry snake-like heads rise from the sleek, serpentine body of this terrifying monster.

heading: Hyena
content: This hyena is covered in shaggy, tan-colored fur with black and brown stripes.

heading: Hyena, Dire
content: This large hyena has a thick head, rheumy red eyes, and a mouth filled with sharp, powerful teeth.

heading: Intellect Devourer
content: Devoid of a head, or any features at all save for four short, clawed legs, this creature's body looks like a large, glistening brain.

heading: Invisible Stalker
content: No true form can be detected, yet a sense of force and hulking malevolence is undeniable in this creature's presence.

heading: Iron Cobra
content: This creature resembles a small, metallic cobra. Its body is made of overlapping iron plates, and its eyes are pinpoints of red light.

heading: Kobold
content: This short, reptilian humanoid has scaled skin, a snout filled with tiny teeth, and a long tail.

heading: Kraken
content: This tremendous leviathan resembles a vast squid, yet the markings on its body are strangely unsettling to look upon.

heading: Kyton
content: Wickedly barbed chains adorn this lean figure, and gaps in the bindings reveal deathly pale flesh etched with jagged scars.

heading: Lamia
content: This creature's upper torso is that of a comely woman with cat's eyes and sharp fangs, while her lower body is that of a lion.

heading: Leech, Giant
content: A parasite ballooned to monstrous proportions undulates in the muck, its circular maw a spiral of teeth.

heading: Lich
content: Once fine robes hang in tatters from this withered corpse's frame. A pale blue light shines from where its eyes should be.

heading: Linnorm, Crag
content: This immense, wingless dragon rears up on a serpentine body. Its triple tail and powerful talons swipe at the air.

heading: Linnorm, Ice
content: A snake-like, dragon-headed monster of tremendous size rises up, drifts of snow and ice tumbling from its coiling flanks.

heading: Linnorm, Tarn
content: This nightmarishly huge, snake-like dragon possesses two equally fearsome heads. Its twin jaws seethe with acid and poison.

heading: Lion
content: This great cat's muscles flex visibly under its skin as it bares its fangs and shakes its thick mane of hair.

heading: Lion, Dire
content: This immense spotted lion stands as tall as a man at the shoulder, its fur matted with the blood of its victims.

heading: Lizard, Giant Frilled
content: This bright-eyed lizard is larger than a horse. As it hisses in anger, a brightly colored frill extends around its neck.

heading: Lizard, Monitor
content: This immense lizard moves with a slow but relentless gait. Its feet end in large talons, and ropes of drool hang from its toothy maw.

heading: Lizardfolk
content: This reptilian humanoid has green scales, a short and toothy snout, and a thick alligator-like tail.

heading: Manticore
content: This creature has a vaguely humanoid head, the body of a lion, and the wings of a dragon. Its tail ends in long, sharp spikes.

heading: Mantis, Giant
content: This towering insect walks on its back four legs. Its head is triangular and its front legs sport razor-sharp edges and claws.

heading: Medusa
content: This slender, attractive woman has strangely glowing eyes and a full head of hissing snakes for hair.

heading: Mephit, Air
content: This small humanoid creature has thin, leathery wings, small horns, and a mischievous smile.

heading: Mephit, Dust
content: This small humanoid creature has thin, leathery wings, small horns, and a mischievous smile.

heading: Mephit, Earth
content: This small humanoid creature has thin, leathery wings, small horns, and a mischievous smile.

heading: Mephit, Fire
content: This small humanoid creature has thin, leathery wings, small horns, and a mischievous smile.

heading: Mephit, Ice
content: This small humanoid creature has thin, leathery wings, small horns, and a mischievous smile.

heading: Mephit, Magma
content: This small humanoid creature has thin, leathery wings, small horns, and a mischievous smile.

heading: Mephit, Ooze
content: This small humanoid creature has thin, leathery wings, small horns, and a mischievous smile.

heading: Mephit, Salt
content: This small humanoid creature has thin, leathery wings, small horns, and a mischievous smile.

heading: Mephit, Steam
content: This small humanoid creature has thin, leathery wings, small horns, and a mischievous smile.

heading: Mephit, Water
content: This small humanoid creature has thin, leathery wings, small horns, and a mischievous smile.

heading: Merfolk
content: Slipping in and out of the crashing waves, this beautiful woman has the lower torso of a long, slender fish.

heading: Mimic
content: What appeared to be a chest filled with treasure comes to life as it grows long, glistening tentacles and a number of sharp teeth.

heading: Minotaur
content: With the body of a powerfully built man and the head of a snarling bull, this creature stomps its hooves as if preparing to charge.

heading: Mite
content: This squat humanoid seems to be nearly all head—an unfortunate circumstance, considering how ugly its puffy blue face is.

heading: Mohrg
content: A thick tangle of discolored entrails clings to this lurching skeleton's torso and winds upward to loll from its jaw like a clawed tongue.

heading: Morlock
content: Skin pale as a slug's belly, eyes huge and bulging, this thing crawls down the wall like a spider, but its shape is hideously humanoid.

heading: Mummy
content: Wrapped from head to toe in ancient strips of moldering linen, this humanoid moves with a shuffling gait.

heading: Naga, Dark
content: A sharp-featured humanoid head crowns the powerful, sinuous body of this snake-like monstrosity.

heading: Naga, Guardian
content: A contemplative humanoid face framed by a cobra-like hood adorns the body of this long, brightly colored serpent.

heading: Naga, Spirit
content: Yellowed, venom-dripping fangs fill the human-like mouth of this sinister serpentine monstrosity.

heading: Neothelid
content: Its slime-drenched length coiled upon itself in a shuddering mountain, this huge worm's tentacled head rises like a snake's.

heading: Night Hag
content: Grisly fetishes and the rags of once fine clothes hang off the corpse-thin frame of this horrifying, sharp-fanged crone.

heading: Nightmare
content: This eerie horse-like creature's skin is an inky blackness. Fire spurts from its hair and nostrils, and its hooves spray sparks.

heading: Nightmare, Cauchemar
content: This towering, burning equine stands upon smoking hooves. Hellfire shimmers in its hateful eyes.

heading: Nymph
content: A delicate figure rises from the water, her long ears tapering to points above her head, her beauty painful in its perfection.

heading: Ochre Jelly
content: This yellow-orange amoeboid creature slithers across the ground, pseudopods grasping ahead of its slow approach.

heading: Octopus
content: Eight tentacles, each adorned with rows of countless suckers, unfurl from the barrel-shaped body of this large-eyed creature.

heading: Octopus, Giant
content: A storm of tentacles, each twenty feet in length, flails with deadly precision from the leathery body of this gigantic octopus.

heading: Ogre
content: This lumbering giant's beady eyes are devoid of wit or kindness, and its puffy face features a wide mouth with ill-fitting teeth.

heading: Oni, Ogre Mage
content: Clad in beautiful armor, this exotically garbed giant roars, its tusks glistening and its eyes afire with murderous intent.

heading: Orc
content: This savage creature looks like a bestial version of a savage human, with green-gray skin and greasy black hair.

heading: Otyugh
content: This three-legged freak is mostly mouth. Three tentacles, two tipped with barbs and one with eyes, extend from its sides.

heading: Owlbear
content: An amalgam of fur and feathers, this bizarre half-bear, half-owl monstrosity raises its huge, ursine claws in anger.

heading: Pegasus
content: This magnificient horse has great bird-like wings upon its back and moves with a quiet and proud grace.

heading: Phase Spider
content: This large spider-like monster has an eerie, humanoid face surrounded by a shaggy mane of fur.

heading: Phoenix
content: This immense bird seems to be made of living flame. It spreads its wings and gives vent to a musical cry as it takes to the air.

heading: Pit Fiend
content: Pit Fiend Outsider

heading: Pixie
content: This tiny, whimsical-looking humanoid darts about swiftly on wildly colored gossamer wings.

heading: Pseudodragon
content: This housecat-sized miniature dragon has fine scales, sharp horns, wicked little teeth, and a tail tipped with a barbed stinger.

heading: Purple Worm
content: This enormous worm is covered with dark purple plates of chitinous armor. Its giant, tooth-filled mouth is the size of an ox.

heading: Rakshasa
content: This figure's backward-bending fingers and its bestial, snarling visage leave little doubt as to its fiendish nature.

heading: Rat, Dire
content: This filthy rat is the size of a small dog. It has a coat of coarse fur, a long and scabby tail, and two glittering eyes.

heading: Remorhaz
content: An immense centipede-like beast erupts from the snow, rows of chitinous plates on its back glowing red-hot.

heading: Retriever
content: A spider the size of a bull elephant rears up on its back four legs in a violent challenge, eyes shimmering with magical energy.

heading: Rhinoceros
content: This rhinoceros has a low-slung head with twisted ears that lie back along its neck.

heading: Rhinoceros, Woolly
content: This large rhinoceros has a shaggy pelt of long, brown fur and a row of immense horns on its snout and brow.

heading: Roc
content: This immense raptor unleashes a shrill cry as it bares its talons, each large enough to carry off a horse.

heading: Roper
content: A huge eye opens in this conical creature's front, just above a toothy mouth. Long strands of fibrous material whip from its sides.

heading: Rust Monster
content: This insectile monster has four legs, a strange propeller-shaped protrusion at the end of its tail, and two long, feathery antennae.

heading: Sahuagin
content: This scaly humanoid has a long, fish-like tail. Its arms and legs end in webbed claws, and its piscine head features a toothy maw.

heading: Salamander
content: This snake-bodied humanoid hisses with anger. Spines of crackling flame dance along the creature's blackened, fiery-red scales.

heading: Satyr
content: This handsome, grinning man has the furry legs of a goat and a set of curling ram horns extending from his temples.

heading: Scorpion, Giant
content: The sixteen-foot-long scorpion scrabbles forward, ferocious claws raised in challenge, stingered tail arched over its back.

heading: Sea Hag
content: Hair like rotting seaweed drapes this ancient witch. Loose, algae-colored skin sags off her starved frame.

heading: Sea Serpent
content: Spine-frilled neck arching up from the water like a snake ready to strike, this ship-sized serpent hisses a challenge.

heading: Shadow
content: Barely seen out of the corner of the eye, this wisp of shadow is vaguely humanoid in outline and writhes with unholy life.

heading: Shadow, Greater
content: This shadowy figure sways and moves with an erratic grace, as if lit by an unseen fire.

heading: Shambling Mound
content: A mass of tangled vines and dripping slime rises on two trunk-like legs, reeking of rot and freshly turned earth.

heading: Shark
content: This blue shark's fins slice through the water, its black eyes rolling and its gaping jaws showing countless teeth.

heading: Shark, Dire
content: Large as a dragon, this shark's jaws open to reveal a cavernous, tooth-lined gullet capable of swallowing a horse whole.

heading: Shocker Lizard
content: This dog-sized lizard has two horns, one on either side of its head, and green scales that crackle with sparks of lightning.

heading: Shoggoth
content: This immense mound of black slime thunders forward, eyes and mouths and even stranger things forming in its heaving bulk.

heading: Skeletal Champion
content: This armored skeleton stands in a battle-ready pose, its weapon held high as cold blue light shines in its eye sockets.

heading: Skum
content: This hunchbacked, green-skinned humanoid has a wide, frog-like head but a mouth more akin to that of a toothy fish.

heading: Slug, Giant
content: This massive, gray-brown slug leaves a viscous trail of slime in its wake as a long rasping tongue tastes the air for prey.

heading: Snake, Constrictor
content: This large snake has a thick, muscular body and dull green scales decorated with dirty brown stripes.

heading: Snake, Venomous
content: This brightly colored snake assumes an aggressive posture, its hissing mouth open to display its fangs.

heading: Spectre
content: This translucent, ghostly figure fades into view from the damp mist, its face distorted by wrath into a hideous mask.

heading: Sphinx
content: This creature has the body of a lion, the wings of a falcon, and the head and torso of a beautiful human woman.

heading: Spider, Giant
content: A spider the size of a man crawls silently from the depths of its funnel-shaped web.

heading: Squid
content: This slender red squid darts through the water with alacrity. Two large eyes stare from above the creature's tentacles.

heading: Squid, Giant
content: Immense in size, this great squid's tentacles writhe and flash with almost nauseating speed. The beast's eyes are as big as shields.

heading: Stirge
content: This insectoid creature has two pairs of bat wings, a tangle of thin legs, and a needle-sharp proboscis.

heading: Svirfneblin
content: This bald gnome has rocky gray skin and a wiry physique. Its pale eyes are overly large and expressive.

heading: Swarm, Army Ant
content: A writhing carpet of ants seethes over the ground, consuming everything in its path.

heading: Swarm, Bat
content: Hundreds of high-pitched squeaks fill the air as a mass of small, carnivorous bats surges forth, all of them hungry for blood.

heading: Swarm, Centipede
content: A writhing mass of legs and poisonous pincers swarms across the ground in a deadly, undulating wave.

heading: Swarm, Crab
content: A writhing mass of clacking shells and snapping pincers rushes from the surf, their spider-like legs twitching across the sand.

heading: Swarm, Leech
content: A mass of wriggling black creatures each the size of a man's finger stirs the stagnant water before enveloping its victim.

heading: Swarm, Rat
content: A squirming, roiling mass of squeaking rats draws closer, teeth flashing and claws scratching everything in its path.

heading: Swarm, Spider
content: An awful, scuttling mass of legs and mandibles scrambles forward out of the darkness.

heading: Swarm, Wasp
content: A low, ominous buzz announces the arrival of a mass of many thousands of angry, stinging wasps.

heading: Tarrasque
content: This immense reptilian beast towers over the surroundings like a dinosaur, all teeth and horns and claws and thrashing spiked tail.

heading: Tengu
content: Black feathers cover this crow-headed humanoid, and its hands and legs end in powerful talons.

heading: Tiefling
content: This lanky man sneers as he draws his sword. Tiny horns and a barbed tail reveal that he is something more than human.

heading: Tiger
content: This powerful feline predator moves with a deadly grace, its reddish-orange fur slashed with black stripes.

heading: Tiger, Dire
content: This large tiger grumbles a warning as it crouches. Two saber-like fangs jut downward from its powerful jaws.

heading: Treant
content: This animated tree's bark is knotted into vaguely humanoid features, with branches for arms and roots for legs.

heading: Troglodyte
content: This humanoid's scaly hide is dull gray. Its frame resembles that of a cave lizard, with a long tail and crests on its head and back.

heading: Troll
content: This tall creature has rough, green hide. Its hands end in claws, and its bestial face has a hideous, tusked underbite.

heading: Unicorn
content: This magnificent beast looks like a white horse, but with a goat's beard and a single long ivory horn on its brow.

heading: Vampire
content: This alluring, raven-haired beauty casually wipes a trickle of blood from a pale cheek, then smiles to reveal needle-sharp fangs.

heading: Vargouille
content: This creature is a blackened, bat-winged fiend's head. Tentacles dangle from chin and scalp, and its fanged mouth hangs agape.

heading: Vegepygmy
content: Short, thin, and green, this small humanoid wields a spear. Tendrils of fungus dangle from its arms, midsection, and legs.

heading: Violet Fungus
content: This mushroom grows from a bed of tentacular roots. Deep violet tendrils slither out of the dozens of fissures in its pointed cap.

heading: Wasp, Giant
content: This horse-sized wasp is covered in yellow and black vertical stripes—its stinger is the size of a sword and drips with venom.

heading: Wererat
content: Wererat Humanoid

heading: Werewolf
content: Werewolf Humanoid

heading: Wight
content: The flesh of this walking corpse is rotting and putrid, its body skeletal in places and its eye sockets glowing with red light.

heading: Wolf
content: This powerful canine watches its prey with piercing yellow eyes, darting its tongue across sharp white teeth.

heading: Wolf, Dire
content: This immense black wolf is the size of a horse, its fangs as large and sharp as knives.

heading: Wolverine
content: This stocky, muscular mammal is the size of a badger, its snarling lips revealing a mouth full of yellow teeth.

heading: Wolverine, Dire
content: This terrible wolverine is as large as a bear, its jaws and claws oversized and brutal, its eyes dark and filled with rage.

heading: Worg
content: This unusually large wolf has an evil, almost intelligent light shining in its deep red eyes.

heading: Worg, Winter Wolf
content: This bear-sized wolf has white fur and a rime of frost around its muzzle. Its eyes are pale blue, almost white in color.

heading: Wraith
content: This ghostly creature is little more than a dark shape with two flickering pinpoints of light where its eyes should be.

heading: Wyvern
content: A dark blue dragon, its wings immense and its tail tipped with a hooked stinger, lands on two taloned feet and roars a challenge.

heading: Xill
content: This flame-red humanoid appears to be a strange mix of insect and reptile, with four arms and twitching, fanged mandibles.

heading: Xorn
content: This squat beast is as wide as it is tall. Strangely symmetrical, it has three arms, three legs, three eyes, and one huge mouth.

heading: Yellow Musk Creeper
content: Coiling around several human skeletons, this wet green plant's sickly flowers smoke with a nasty yellow vapor.

heading: Yeth Hound
content: This emaciated, hairless canine has a strange air of menace and cruelty about it.

heading: Yeti
content: This creature stands like a man, yet is half again the height of most men and covered with a coat of thick white fur.

heading: Armor Spikes
content: You can have spikes added to your armor, which allow you to deal extra piercing damage (see "spiked armor" on Table: Weapons) on a successful grapple attack. The spikes count as a martial weapon. If y

heading: Banded Mail
content: Banded mail is made up of overlapping strips of metal, fastened to a leather backing. The suit includes gauntlets.

heading: Breastplate
content: Covering only the torso, a breastplate is made up of a single piece of sculpted metal.

heading: Buckler
content: This small metal shield is worn strapped to your forearm. You can use a bow or crossbow without penalty while carrying it. You can also use your shield arm to wield a weapon (whether you are using an

heading: Chain Shirt
content: Covering the torso, this shirt is made up of thousands of interlocking metal rings.

heading: Chainmail
content: Unlike a chain shirt, chainmail covers the legs and arms of the wearer. The suit includes gauntlets.

heading: Full Plate
content: This metal suit includes gauntlets, heavy leather boots, a visored helmet, and a thick layer of padding that is worn underneath the armor. Each suit of full plate must be individually fitted to its ow

heading: Gauntlet, Locked
content: This armored gauntlet has small chains and braces that allow the wearer to attach a weapon to the gauntlet so that it cannot be dropped easily. It provides a +10 bonus to your Combat Maneuver Defense

heading: Half-Plate
content: Combining elements of full plate and chainmail, half-plate includes gauntlets and a helm.

heading: Hide
content: Hide armor is made up of the tanned and preserved skin of any thick-hided beast.

heading: Leather
content: Leather armor is made up of pieces of hard boiled leather carefully sewn together.

heading: Padded
content: Little more than heavy, quilted cloth, this armor provides only the most basic protection.

heading: Scale Mail
content: Scale mail is made up of dozens of small overlapping metal plates. The suit includes gauntlets.

heading: Shield, Heavy; Wooden
content: You strap a shield to your forearm and grip it with your hand. A heavy shield is so heavy that you can't use your shield hand for anything else.

heading: Shield, Heavy; Steel
content: You strap a shield to your forearm and grip it with your hand. A heavy shield is so heavy that you can't use your shield hand for anything else.

heading: Shield, Light; Wooden
content: You strap a shield to your forearm and grip it with your hand. A light shield's weight lets you carry other items in that hand, although you cannot use weapons with it.

heading: Shield, Light; Steel
content: You strap a shield to your forearm and grip it with your hand. A light shield's weight lets you carry other items in that hand, although you cannot use weapons with it.

heading: Shield, Tower
content: This massive wooden shield is nearly as tall as you are. In most situations, it provides the indicated shield bonus to your AC. As a standard action, however, you can use a tower shield to grant you t

heading: Shield Spikes
content: These spikes turn a shield into a martial piercing weapon and increase the damage dealt by a shield bash as if the shield were designed for a creature one size category larger than you (see "spiked sh

heading: Splint Mail
content: Splint mail is made up of metal strips, like banded mail. The suit includes gauntlets.

heading: Studded Leather
content: Similar to leather armor, this suit is reinforced with small metal studs.

heading: Artisan's Outfit
content: This outfit includes a shirt with buttons, a skirt or pants with a drawstring, shoes, and perhaps a cap or hat. It may also include a belt or a leather or cloth apron for carrying tools.

heading: Cleric's Vestments
content: These clothes are for performing priestly functions, not for adventuring. Cleric's vestments typically include a cassock, stole, and surplice.

heading: Cold-Weather Outfit
content: This outfit includes a wool coat, linen shirt, wool cap, heavy cloak, thick pants or skirt, and boots. This outfit grants a +5 circumstance bonus on Fortitude saving throws against exposure to cold we

heading: Courtier's Outfit
content: This outfit includes fancy, tailored clothes in whatever fashion happens to be the current style in the courts of the nobles. Anyone trying to influence nobles or courtiers while wearing street dress

heading: Entertainer's Outfit
content: This set of flashy--perhaps even gaudy--clothes is for entertaining. While the outfit looks whimsical, its practical design lets you tumble, dance, walk a tightrope, or just run (if the audience turns

heading: Explorer's Outfit
content: This set of clothes is for someone who never knows what to expect. It includes sturdy boots, leather breeches or a skirt, a belt, a shirt (perhaps with a vest or jacket), gloves, and a cloak. Rather t

heading: Monk's Outfit
content: This simple outfit includes sandals, loose breeches, and a loose shirt, and is bound together with sashes. The outfit is designed to give you maximum mobility, and it's made of high-quality fabric. Yo

heading: Noble's Outfit
content: These clothes are designed specifically to be expensive and gaudy. Precious metals and gems are worked into the clothing. A would-be noble also needs a signet ring and jewelry (worth at least 100 gp)

heading: Peasant's Outfit
content: This set of clothes consists of a loose shirt and baggy breeches, or a loose shirt and skirt or overdress. Cloth wrappings are used for shoes.

heading: Royal Outfit
content: This is just the clothing, not the royal scepter, crown, ring, and other accoutrements. Royal clothes are ostentatious, with gems, gold, silk, and fur in abundance.

heading: Scholar's Outfit
content: Perfect for a scholar, this outfit includes a robe, a belt, a cap, soft shoes, and possibly a cloak.

heading: Traveler's Outfit
content: This set of clothes consists of boots, a wool skirt or breeches, a sturdy belt, a shirt (perhaps with a vest or jacket), and an ample cloak with a hood.

heading: Inn
content: Poor accommodations at an inn amount to a place on the floor near the hearth. Common accommodations consist of a place on a raised, heated floor and the use of a blanket and a pillow. Good accommodati

heading: Meals
content: Poor meals might be composed of bread, baked turnips, onions, and water. Common meals might consist of bread, chicken stew, carrots, and watered-down ale or wine. Good meals might be composed of bread

heading: Barding, Medium Creature and Large Creature
content: Barding is a type of armor that covers the head, neck, chest, body, and possibly legs of a horse or other mount. Barding made of medium or heavy armor provides better protection than light barding, bu

heading: Bit and Bridle
content: This is headgear used by a rider to control a mount. Bit and bridles for horses, ponies, and riding dogs can be readily purchased in most settlements and bits and bridles can be crafted for any creatu

heading: Dog, Guard
content: This Small, combat-trained dog is bred for battle; breeders favor strength, a thick body, and a low center of gravity. Guard dogs are sold in most large cities and some cultures use them for sport fig

heading: Dog, Riding
content: This Medium dog is specially trained to carry a Small humanoid rider. It is brave in combat like a combat-trained horse. Due to its smaller stature, you take no damage when you fall from a riding dog.

heading: Donkey or Mule
content: Donkeys and mules are stolid in the face of danger, hardy, surefooted, and capable of carrying heavy loads over vast distances. Unlike a horse, a donkey or a mule is willing (though not eager) to ente

heading: Feed
content: Horses, donkeys, mules, and ponies can graze to sustain themselves, but providing feed for them is better. If you have a riding dog, you have to feed it meat.

heading: Horse
content:
A horse is suitable as a mount for a human, dwarf, elf, half-elf, or half-orc. A pony is smaller than a horse and is a suitable mount for a gnome or halfling.

A war-trained horse can be ridden into c

heading: Saddlebags

heading: Saddle, Exotic
content: An exotic saddle is designed for an unusual mount. Exotic saddles come in military, pack, and riding styles.

heading: Saddle, Military
content: This saddle braces the rider, providing a +2 circumstance bonus on Ride checks related to staying in the saddle. If you're knocked unconscious while in a military saddle, you have a 75% chance to stay

heading: Saddle, Pack
content: A pack saddle holds gear and supplies, but not a rider. It holds as much gear as the mount can carry.

heading: Saddle, Riding
content: If you are knocked unconscious while in a riding saddle, you have a 50% chance to stay in the saddle.

heading: Stabling
content: This is the amount it costs to stable a single creature that is Large or smaller for one day, at a typical stable or hostler. Particularly fancy stables may cost more, and larger or more exotic creatu

heading: Coach Cab
content: The price given is for a ride in a coach that transports people (and light cargo) between towns. For a ride in a cab that transports passengers within a city, 1 copper piece usually takes you anywhere

heading: Hireling, Trained
content: The amount given is the typical daily wage for mercenary warriors, masons, craftsmen, cooks, scribes, teamsters, and other trained hirelings. This value represents a minimum wage; many such hirelings

heading: Hireling, Untrained
content: The amount shown is the typical daily wage for laborers, maids, and other menial workers.

heading: Messenger
content: This includes horse-riding messengers and runners. Those willing to carry a message to a place they were going anyway may ask for only half the indicated amount.

heading: Road or Gate Toll

heading: Ship's Passage
content: Most ships do not specialize in passengers, but many have the capability to take a few along when transporting cargo. Double the given cost for creatures larger than Medium or creatures that are other

heading: Alchemist's Lab
content: This lab is used for making alchemical items, and provides a +2 circumstance bonus on Craft (alchemy) checks. It has no bearing on the costs related to the Craft (alchemy) skill. Without this lab, a c

heading: Artisan's Tools
content: These special tools include the items needed to pursue any craft. Without them, you have to use improvised tools (-2 penalty on Craft checks), if you can do the job at all.

heading: Artisan's Tools, Masterwork
content: These tools serve the same purpose as artisan's tools, but masterwork artisan's tools are the perfect tools for the job, so you get a +2 circumstance bonus on Craft checks made with them.

heading: Climber's Kit
content: These crampons, pitons, ropes, and tools give you a +2 circumstance bonus on Climb checks.

heading: Disguise Kit
content: The kit is the perfect tool for disguise and provides a +2 circumstance bonus on Disguise checks. A disguise kit is exhausted after 10 uses.

heading: Healer's Kit
content: This collection of bandages and herbs provides a +2 circumstance bonus on Heal checks. A healer's kit is exhausted after 10 uses.

heading: Holly and Mistletoe
content: Druids commonly use these plants as divine focuses when casting spells.

heading: Holy Symbol, Silver or Wooden
content: A holy symbol focuses positive energy and is used by good clerics and paladins (or by neutral clerics who want to cast good spells or channel positive energy). Each religion has its own holy symbol.

heading: Magnifying Glass
content: This simple lens allows a closer look at small objects. It is also useful as a substitute for flint and steel when starting fires. Lighting a fire with a magnifying glass requires bright light, such a

heading: Musical Instrument, Common or Masterwork
content: A masterwork instrument grants a +2 circumstance bonus on Perform checks involving its use.

heading: Scale, Merchant's
content: A merchant's scale grants a +2 circumstance bonus on Appraise checks involving items that are valued by weight, including anything made of precious metals.

heading: Spell Component Pouch
content: A spellcaster with a spell component pouch is assumed to have all the material components and focuses needed for spellcasting, except for those components that have a specific cost, divine focuses, an

heading: Spellbook, Wizard's
content: A spellbook has 100 pages of parchment, and each spell takes up one page per spell level (one page each for 0-level spells).

heading: Thieves' Tools
content: This kit contains lockpicks and other tools you need to use the Disable Device skill. Without these tools, you must use improvised tools, and you take a -2 circumstance penalty on Disable Device check

heading: Thieves' Tools, Masterwork
content: This kit contains extra tools and tools of better make, which grant a +2 circumstance bonus on Disable Device checks.

heading: Tool, Masterwork
content: This well-made item is the perfect tool for the job. It grants a +2 circumstance bonus on a related skill check (if any). Bonuses provided by multiple masterwork items do not stack.

heading: Carriage
content: This four-wheeled vehicle can transport as many as four people within an enclosed cab, plus two drivers. In general, two horses (or other beasts of burden) draw it. A carriage comes with the harness n

heading: Cart
content: This two-wheeled vehicle can be drawn by a single horse (or other beast of burden). It comes with a harness.

heading: Galley
content: This three-masted ship has 70 oars on either side and requires a total crew of 200. A galley is 130 feet long and 20 feet wide, and can carry 150 tons of cargo or 250 soldiers. For 8,000 gp more, it c

heading: Keelboat
content: This 50- to 75-foot-long ship is 15 to 20 feet wide and has a few oars to supplement its single mast with a square sail. It has a crew of 8 to 15 and can carry 40 to 50 tons of cargo or 100 soldiers.

heading: Longship
content: This 75-foot-long ship with 40 oars requires a total crew of 50. It has a single mast and a square sail, and it can carry 50 tons of cargo or 120 soldiers. A longship can make sea voyages. It moves ab

heading: Rowboat
content: This 8- to 12-foot-long boat with two oars holds two or three Medium passengers. It moves about 1-1/2 miles per hour.

heading: Oar
content: A standard wooden oar used to propel a boat.

heading: Sailing Ship
content: This large, seaworthy ship is 75 to 90 feet long and 20 feet wide, and has a crew of 20. It can carry 150 tons of cargo. It has square sails on its two masts and can make sea voyages. It moves about 2

heading: Sled
content: This is a wagon on runners for snow and ice travel. In general, two horses (or other beasts of burden) draw it. A sled comes with the harness needed to pull it.

heading: Wagon
content: A four-wheeled, open vehicle for transporting heavy loads. Two horses (or other beasts of burden) must draw it. A wagon comes with the harness needed to pull it.

heading: Warship
content: This 100-foot-long ship has a single mast, although oars can also propel it. It has a crew of 60 to 80 rowers. This ship can carry 160 soldiers, but not for long distances, since there isn't room for

heading: Arrows
content: An arrow used as a melee weapon is treated as a light improvised weapon (-4 penalty on attack rolls) and deals damage as a dagger of its size (critical multiplier ×2). Arrows come in a leather quiver

heading: Axe, Orc Double
content: A cruel weapon with blades placed at opposite ends of a long haft, an orc double axe is a double weapon.

heading: Battleaxe
content: The handle of this axe is long enough that you can wield it one-handed or two-handed. The head may have one blade or two, with blade shapes ranging from half-moons to squared edges like narrower versi

heading: Blowgun
content: Blowguns are generally used to deliver debilitating (but rarely fatal) poisons from a distance. They are nearly silent when fired. For a list of appropriate poisons, see Poison.

heading: Blowgun Darts
content: The thin, light darts used in a blowgun are usually made of hardwood with a stabilizing fletching of down or fur. A dart is usually loaded from the back end just before firing.

heading: Bolas
content: A bolas is a pair of weights, connected by a thin rope or cord. You can use this weapon to make a ranged trip attack against an opponent. You can't be tripped during your own trip attempt when using a

heading: Bolts
content: A crossbow bolt used as a melee weapon is treated as a light improvised weapon (-4 penalty on attack rolls) and deals damage as a dagger of its size (crit ×2). Bolts come in a case or quiver that hold

heading: Bullets, Sling
content: Bullets are shaped metal balls, designed to be used by a sling or halfling sling staff. Bullets come in a leather pouch that holds 10 bullets.

heading: Chain, Spiked
content: A spiked chain is about 4 feet in length, covered in wicked barbs. You can use the Weapon Finesse feat to apply your Dexterity modifier instead of your Strength modifier to attack rolls with a spiked

heading: Club
content: This weapon is usually just a shaped piece of wood, sometimes with a few nails or studs embedded in it.

heading: Crossbow, Hand
content:
You can draw a hand crossbow back by hand. Loading a hand crossbow is a move action that provokes attacks of opportunity.

You can shoot, but not load, a hand crossbow with one hand at no penalty. You

heading: Crossbow, Heavy
content:
You draw a heavy crossbow back by turning a small winch. Loading a heavy crossbow is a full-round action that provokes attacks of opportunity.

Normally, operating a heavy crossbow requires two hands.

heading: Crossbow, Light
content:
You draw a light crossbow back by pulling a lever. Loading a light crossbow is a move action that provokes attacks of opportunity.

Normally, operating a light crossbow requires two hands. However, yo

heading: Crossbow, Repeating Heavy
content: The repeating crossbow (whether heavy or light) holds 5 crossbow bolts. As long as it holds bolts, you can reload it by pulling the reloading lever (a free action). Loading a new case of 5 bolts is a

heading: Crossbow, Repeating Light
content: The repeating crossbow (whether heavy or light) holds 5 crossbow bolts. As long as it holds bolts, you can reload it by pulling the reloading lever (a free action). Loading a new case of 5 bolts is a

heading: Curve Blade, Elven
content: Essentially a longer version of a scimitar, but with a thinner blade, the elven curve blade is exceptionally rare. You receive a +2 circumstance bonus to your Combat Maneuver Defense whenever a foe at

heading: Dagger
content: A dagger has a blade that is about 1 foot in length. You get a +2 bonus on Sleight of Hand skill checks made to conceal a dagger on your body (see Using Skills).

heading: Dagger, Punching
content: A punching dagger's blade is attached to a horizontal handle that projects out from the fist when held.

heading: Dart
content: This thrown weapon is larger than an arrow and shorter than a javelin, with a weighted tip and a shorter range than a javelin. Most darts are wooden shafts with a thick metal point.

heading: Falchion
content: This sword has one curved, sharp edge like a scimitar, with the back edge unsharpened and either flat or slightly curved. Its weight is greater toward the end, making it better for chopping rather tha

heading: Flail
content: A flail consists of a spiked metal ball, connected to a handle by a sturdy chain.

heading: Flail, Dire
content: A dire flail consists of two spheres of spiked iron dangling from chains at opposite ends of a long haft.

heading: Flail, Heavy
content: Similar to a flail, a heavy flail has a larger metal ball and a longer handle.

heading: Gauntlet
content: This metal glove lets you deal lethal damage rather than nonlethal damage with unarmed strikes. A strike with a gauntlet is otherwise considered an unarmed attack. The cost and weight given are for a

heading: Gauntlet, Spiked
content: The cost and weight given are for a single gauntlet. An attack with a spiked gauntlet is considered an armed attack. Your opponent cannot use a disarm action to disarm you of spiked gauntlets.

heading: Glaive
content: A glaive is a simple blade, mounted to the end of a pole about 7 feet in length.

heading: Greataxe
content: This two-handed battle axe is heavy enough that you can't wield it with one hand. The head may have one blade or two, and may be "bearded" (meaning hooked or trailing at the bottom) to increase cleavi

heading: Greatclub
content: This larger, bulkier version of the common club is heavy enough that you can't wield it with one hand. It may be ornate and carved, reinforced with metal, or a simple branch from a tree. Like simple c

heading: Greatsword
content: This immense two-handed sword is about 5 feet in length.

heading: Guisarme
content: A guisarme is an 8-foot-long shaft with a blade and a hook mounted at the tip.

heading: Halberd
content: A halberd is similar to a 5-foot-long spear, but it also has a small, axe-like head mounted near the tip.

heading: Hammer, Gnome Hooked
content: A gnome hooked hammer is a double weapon--an ingenious tool with a hammer head at one end of its haft and a long, curved pick at the other. The hammer's blunt head is a bludgeoning weapon that deals 1

heading: Handaxe
content: This one-handed axe is short (roughly 1 foot long) and designed for use with one hand. Unlike throwing axes, it is not well balanced for a graceful tumbling motion, and is instead heavier at its head.

heading: Heavy Pick
content: This variant of the light pick has a longer handle and can be used with one or two hands. It is a common, inexpensive weapon for mounted soldiers since it can be used effectively from horseback.

heading: Javelin
content: A javelin is a thin throwing spear . Since it is not designed for melee, you are treated as nonproficient with it and take a -4 penalty on attack rolls if you use a javelin as a melee weapon.

heading: Kama
content: Similar to a sickle, a kama is a short, curved blade attached to a simple handle.

heading: Kukri
content: A kukri is a curved blade, about 1 foot in length.

heading: Lance
content: A lance deals double damage when used from the back of a charging mount. While mounted, you can wield a lance with one hand.

heading: Light Hammer
content: A lighter version of a warhammer, this weapon usually has a sleek metal head with one striking surface.

heading: Light Pick
content: This weapon, adapted from the pickaxe tool, has a head with a slightly curved, armor-piercing spike and a hammerlike counterweight.

heading: Longbow
content: At almost 5 feet in height, a longbow is made up of one solid piece of carefully curved wood. You need two hands to use a bow, regardless of its size. A longbow is too unwieldy to use while you are mo

heading: Longbow, Composite
content: You need at least two hands to use a bow, regardless of its size. You can use a composite longbow while mounted. All composite bows are made with a particular strength rating (that is, each requires a

heading: Longspear
content: A longspear is about 8 feet in length.

heading: Longsword
content: This sword is about 3-1/2 feet in length.

heading: Mace
content: A mace is made up of an ornate metal head attached to a simple wooden or metal shaft.

heading: Mace, Heavy
content: A heavy mace has a larger head and a longer handle than a normal mace.

heading: Morningstar
content: A morningstar is a spiked metal ball, affixed to the top of a long handle.

heading: Net

content: Similar in appearance to a trident, a ranseur has a single spear at its tip, flanked by a pair of short, curving blades.

content: A spear is 5 feet in length and can be thrown.

heading: Spiked Shield, Heavy
content: You can bash with a spiked shield instead of using it for defense.

heading: Spiked Shield, Light
content: You can bash with a spiked shield instead of using it for defense.

heading: Starknife
content: From a central metal ring, four tapering metal blades extend like points on a compass rose. A wielder can stab with the starknife or throw it.

content: A trident has three metal prongs at end of a 4-foot-long shaft. This weapon can be thrown.

content: The creature is unable to see well because of overstimulation of the eyes. A dazzled creature takes a -1 penalty on attack rolls and sight-based Perception checks.

content: A shaken character takes a -2 penalty on attack rolls, saving throws, skill checks, and ability checks. Shaken is a less severe state of fear than frightened or panicked.

heading: Sickened
content: The character takes a -2 penalty on all attack rolls, weapon damage rolls, saving throws, skill checks, and ability checks.

heading: Stunned
content: A stunned creature drops everything held, can't take actions, takes a -2 penalty to AC, and loses its Dexterity bonus to AC (if any).

heading: Unconscious
content: Unconscious creatures are knocked out and helpless. Unconsciousness can result from having negative hit points (but not more than the creature's Constitution score), or from nonlethal damage in excess

heading: Acrobatics
content: You can keep your balance while traversing narrow or treacherous surfaces. You can also dive, flip, jump, and roll to avoid attacks and overcome obstacles.

heading: Appraise
content: You can evaluate the monetary value of an object.

heading: Bluff
content: You know how to tell a lie.

heading: Climb
content: You are skilled at scaling vertical surfaces, from smooth city walls to rocky cliffs.

heading: Craft

heading: Diplomacy
content: You can use this skill to persuade others to agree with your arguments, to resolve differences, and to gather valuable information or rumors from people. This skill is also used to negotiate conflicts

heading: Disable Device
content: You are skilled at disarming traps and opening locks. In addition, this skill lets you sabotage simple mechanical devices, such as catapults, wagon wheels, and doors.

heading: Disguise
content: You are skilled at changing your appearance.

heading: Escape Artist
content: Your training allows you to slip out of bonds and escape from grapples.

heading: Fly
content: You are skilled at flying, through either the use of wings or magic, and can perform daring or complex maneuvers while airborne. Note that this skill does not give you the ability to fly.

heading: Handle Animal
content: You are trained at working with animals, and can teach them tricks, get them to follow your simple commands, or even domesticate them.

heading: Heal
content: You are skilled at tending to wounds and ailments.

heading: Intimidate
content: You can use this skill to frighten an opponent or to get them to act in a way that benefits you. This skill includes verbal threats and displays of prowess.

heading: Knowledge
content: You are educated in a field of study and can answer both simple and complex questions. Like the Craft, Perform, and Profession skills, Knowledge actually encompasses a number of different specialties.

heading: Linguistics
content: You are skilled at working with language, in both its spoken and written forms. You can speak multiple languages, and can decipher nearly any tongue given enough time. Your skill in writing allows you

heading: Perception
content: Your senses allow you to notice fine details and alert you to danger. Perception covers all five senses, including sight, hearing, touch, taste, and smell.

heading: Perform
content: You are skilled at one form of entertainment, from singing to acting to playing an instrument. Like Craft, Knowledge, and Profession, Perform is actually a number of separate skills. You could have se

heading: Profession
content: You are skilled at a specific job. Like Craft, Knowledge, and Perform, Profession is actually a number of separate skills. You could have several Profession skills, each with its own ranks. While a Cr

heading: Ride
content: You are skilled at riding mounts, usually a horse, but possibly something more exotic, like a griffon or pegasus. If you attempt to ride a creature that is ill suited as a mount, you take a -5 penalty

heading: Sense Motive
content: You are skilled at detecting falsehoods and true intentions.

heading: Sleight of Hand
content: Your training allows you to pick pockets, draw hidden weapons, and take a variety of actions without being noticed.

heading: Spellcraft
content: You are skilled at the art of casting spells, identifying magic items, crafting magic items, and identifying spells as they are being cast.

heading: Stealth
content: You are skilled at avoiding detection, allowing you to slip past foes or strike from an unseen position. This skill covers hiding and moving silently.

heading: Survival
content: You are skilled at surviving in the wild and at navigating in the wilderness. You also excel at following trails and tracks left by others.

heading: Swim
content: You know how to swim and can do so even in stormy water.

heading: Use Magic Device
content: You are skilled at activating magic items, even if you are not otherwise trained in their use.
